title: Build a reliable stone program with a manufacturing partner in Vietnam.
intro: WHITEROCK supports distributors, home-center suppliers, fabricators, builders, hospitality buyers, and project contractors with samples, drawings, repeat production, export packing, and shipment coordination.

terms.title: Program MOQ
terms.copy: Typical starting quantities are 10–20 pieces per style or color; final MOQ depends on material, size, and packaging.

terms.title: Lead Time
terms.copy: Most production programs are quoted at 25–55 days after sample, drawing, deposit, and material approval.

terms.title: Samples
terms.copy: Color chips and selected product samples can be prepared for buyer review before volume production.

terms.title: Export Support
terms.copy: Commercial invoices, packing lists, product labels, export crates, and loading coordination are available by order.
